checks.name: creating a grant in the editor shows its token once with the MCP endpoint; the default mode is "propose"; the token sees only this project, cannot commit an edit directly, and cannot read another project
after dismissing, the token is no longer shown; revoking the grant in the editor stops the token immediately
the crossfade control fades the selected clip in from the clip before it (0.2 s = 6 frames on both sides, earlier clip extended)
loop playback: with loop on, a 1-second timeline wraps around at least twice and keeps playing; turning loop off lets it stop at the end

project manager: lists the projects; delete is disabled until the exact name is typed, then removes the project; storage check is a dry run; Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to the button that opened it
"new project" creates it and opens it in the editor
no uncaught errors in the page
